description.value: The Dawson Creek & District Memorial Arena is a municipal ice arena serving the community at the southern end of the Alaska Highway. As a city-operated sports centre, it hosts ice sports, community events, and recreational skating. Touring cyclists passing through Dawson Creek — the Mile Zero of the Alaska Highway — may find it a useful landmark and rest stop.
